exposure: Pre-pregnancy care vs. no pre-pregnancy care
Nulliparous women using CSII with a longer history of diabetes
outcome: HbA1c levels at booking to antenatal services
finding: Pre-pregnancy care delivered by a specialist multi-disciplinary team effectively reduces HbA1c levels peri-conception.
mod_finding: CSII use results in lower HbA1c levels in pre-pregnancy care in selected individuals and was associated with higher Caesarean section rates.
